title: Space Shuttle RTLS Abort Challenge - Without The Manual
summary: Scott Manley tries a Space Shuttle Return To Launch Site abort in the Orbiter simulator without manuals or checklists. He explains how the maneuver works and where his attempt went wrong.
why: HN links it to illustrate how the shuttle's never-flown RTLS abort profile would work.

quote.text: Scott Manley did a video a few years back explaining how this return profile works
